title: A Spectral Confounder Adjustment for Spatial Regression with Multiple Exposures and Outcomes

split.decision: Original create_set7; independent offline full 5 settings x 12 replicates x n=400 splits. Input holds observed X/Y only; truth and generation seeds are separate.

baseline.paper_ref: Paper MSE 0.039; historical reproduction 0.038847. No converted full reference was run.

allowed_changes: Posterior sampling, variational or other approximation, numerical parameterization and optimization may change while targeting the same posterior and summaries.
Iterations, burn-in, scheduling and auxiliary approximation losses are solver choices; unscored Naive/Spatial+/USM comparison fits may be omitted.

When retaining the supplied Gibbs/Metropolis sampler, changing only iters=5000, burn=1000, MH=0.1 or its warm-up adaptation settings (att>50, acceptance bounds 0.3 and 0.5, multipliers 0.8 and 1.2) does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Improve posterior computation for the specified multivariate spectral confounder model, evaluated through its first-frequency exposure-effect posterior means and 95% credible intervals.
The MSM likelihood, shared tensor spectral effect parameterization, horseshoe/hierarchical priors and hyperparameters in functions_sim.R, L=10 and K=5 define the target posterior.
First-frequency posterior means and equal-tailed 2.5%/97.5% quantiles, nine non-intercept exposures/five outcomes, fixed five settings, equal MSE and per-setting strict coverage >=.93 remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace the MSM likelihood/tensor/prior model with an ordinary regression or change the posterior quantities to generic estimates/intervals.
Do not change basis/rank model controls L/K, use hidden confounders/effects, pool independent cases or alter observed X/Y and scoring.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
